title: Soul Glo’s Diaspora Problems is a hardcore record like no other
summary: The front chunk of the record is just perfect unrelenting hardcore song after perfect unrelenting hardcore song. Next to other modern hardcore standard bearers like Turnstile, Soul Glo might almost seem like traditionalists heavily influenced by the DC scene.
